Choose one of the following:

Aide Voyage Logbook (Adventure)
Aide Voyage Logbook (Trade)
Aide Voyage Logbook (Battle)

You can get these from Fortune (Great Luck)

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: This will become Monthly Bonus Reward from 6th March - 8th May. While it is not as precious as previous Monthly Reward (And must choose one of the three Logbooks inside, yuck), still good if you want to raise aide levels.
